entities.summary: Fiona Kolbinger is a German ultra-endurance cyclist, researcher and medical doctor. She was the winner of the Transcontinental Race in 2019 winning in a time of 10 days 2 hours and 48 minutes with an advance of more than ten hours over the second closest, Ben Davies. She was the first woman to ever win the race, beating a field of over 224 men and 40 women. In recognition of her athletic achievements, she was part of the BBC's 100 women of 2019.
